templates.title: Savory oat bowl
steps: Cook the oats according to their package instructions.
Fold in the available vegetables and serve with yogurt.

templates.title: Chickpea and tomato salad
steps: Drain and rinse cooked or canned chickpeas.
Combine with the available vegetables and season to taste.

templates.title: Pantry vegetable toast
steps: Top with the available vegetables; use yogurt as an optional spread.
